name: web-sdk-pin
description: Pins the exact @tiro-health/web-sdk version embedded in Tiro.Health.FormFiller.WebView2 (GH-59/GH-60). Single source of truth: copy-bundle.mjs stages this version's bundle for embedding, and CI type-checks the shipped bridge against it. tiro.expectedElementVersion arms the host-side handshake version assert (GH-61) — keep it null until the pin reaches the first web-sdk release that exposes a static element version (atticus-frontend#2927), then keep it equal to the pinned version.
